module.title: Check complete responses before buying registration verification

domain.label: Order fulfillment
domain.description: Review delivery commitments, operating prerequisites and shipment arrangements.

useCase.label: Review a first shipment
useCase.description: Review one shipment before committing money to an arrangement.

module.description: Compare complete direct and backup arrangements, then repeat every operating check at the proposed registration-check response time. Readiness remains unresolved until a trusted scoped confirmation is actually received. A passing plan is a proposal, not a reservation or operating authorization.
module.question: Which complete arrangement can meet this shipment commitment under every remaining transportation state?

units.timeOrigin: Minute 0 is 2026-11-17T00:00:00-06:00; fixed UTC-06:00 for this bounded shipment horizon.

assumptions: This hypothetical case contains one accepted order revision for 100 cases, two complete mutually exclusive arrangements, and a fixed receipt commitment.
Both registered and not_registered remain logically admitted. Machine-learning probabilities never remove a mandatory operating scenario or establish registration.
Direct transportation requires registered SP-A. The backup uses independently registered SP-B in either state. Portal presence does not establish transportation registration.
Each arrangement includes all packing, release and freight expense in its quoted fee. Preparation and resource use are explicitly checked and add no separate charge.
The accepted 100 cases are stipulated to be available to either complete arrangement; this profile does not perform inventory allocation, manufacturing or replenishment.
The complete issued-grant registry, calendar, bookings and quoted capacities remain stable. Computing a proposal does not purchase verification, reserve freight, grant permission or release stock.
All tasks use half-open intervals. Packing starts when the arrangement can be selected; final release follows packing and must finish before the fixed offered departure.
Reservation must be possible by minute 720, independently of receipt by minute 5340. Equal-time completion at either inclusive deadline is allowed.

studyFee is one prospective or incurred verification fee counted once. The payment time is studyFeeAt, and the complete quoted arrangement fee is paid when that arrangement can be selected. There are no deposits, refunds, revenue or additional financing.
A complete static arrangement is assessed against every retained state. Learning may later choose among these complete arrangements only through separately checked report branches.

A nonzero verification fee needs an independently recorded scoped purchase grant and study-purchase cap at its payment time. Missing authority cannot be replaced by available budget or positive expected benefit.

requirements.label: Complete accepted order
requirements.meaning: The arrangement carries the accepted quantity using a transportation-registered ship point for this exact shipment scope.

requirements.label: Preparation staff and workspace
requirements.meaning: Packing and release have the necessary capabilities, calendars and shared capacity for their complete durations.

requirements.label: Purchase, arrangement and final release permission
requirements.meaning: Recorded authorities cover verification purchase, arrangement selection and final release for the same order revision, recipient, shipment date and profile. A budget ceiling does not create permission.

requirements.label: Reservation, preparation and receipt
requirements.meaning: Select by the reservation cutoff, finish preparation before departure and meet the receipt deadline.

requirements.label: Receiving window
requirements.meaning: Arrival falls within the declared half-open receiving window.

requirements.label: Total expense and cash
requirements.meaning: The quoted arrangement fee plus the single prospective or incurred verification fee stay within expense and peak-cash limits.

labels.constraint.pack-availability: Packing worker is available for the full task
labels.constraint.release-capability: Release officer has the required capability
labels.constraint.release-availability: Release officer is available for the full task
labels.constraint.combined-resource-capacity: Shared preparation resources have enough capacity

labels.constraint.scoped-final-release-grant: Final release has a current scoped permission
labels.constraint.selection-not-in-the-past: Selection occurs at or after the assessment time
labels.constraint.verification-fee-before-respo: The check is paid before its response is selected
labels.constraint.reserve-before-cutoff: The arrangement is selected before the reservation cutoff
labels.constraint.preparation-before-departure: Packing and release finish before departure
labels.constraint.receipt-within-access-window: Receipt falls within the receiving window
labels.constraint.total-expense-limit: Complete expense stays within the spending limit
labels.constraint.peak-cash-limit: Peak cash stays within the available cash
